title: Stop Getting Lost on Airport Taxiways! (FREE NavApron Setup for MSFS/MSFS2024)
description:
Struggling to navigate complex airport taxiways or looking for a moving map without paying for an expensive subscription? In this video, we test and set up NavApron (v0.8.1 Beta)—a 100% free, standalone web-server companion tool for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 and MSFS 2020.

NavApron allows you to import your SimBrief flight plans, view OpenStreetMap-based apron charts, compute custom ATC taxi clearances, log your flights, and track your aircraft in real time via SimConnect, all on your main PC, a second monitor, or any external iPad/tablet browser!

✈️ FLIGHT & SIM DETAILS:
Simulator: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 / MSFS 2020
Aircraft: Fenix Simulations Airbus A320-200
Departure Airport: Amsterdam Airport Schiphol (EHAM)
Destination Airport: Adolfo Suárez Madrid–Barajas Airport (LEMD)
Tool Featured: NavApron (Created by Robert Ferry)
